# Rgsdev character art

- Asset pack: **Free 2D Animated Vector Game Character Sprites**
- Author: **Raphael Gonçalves (Rgsdev)**
- Creator: https://rgsdev.itch.io/
- License: **CC0**, according to the original `License.txt` included with this pack.
- Original license and creator shortcuts are preserved in this directory.
- Art location: `Assets/Resources/Art/Rgsdev/`.

The lobby uses Char 1–4's idle body/feet slices for local character previews.
Weapon sprites (weaponR1–weaponR3), other animation frames, body parts, environment
and effects are retained for future use. Equipment now shows placeholders until
service data is available. Source PNGs and importer GUIDs are unchanged. The editor builder arranges
the separate character slices using their original sprite-sheet coordinates.

Lobby UI uses a separately generated cartoon sprite atlas. See
[`../CREDITS.md`](../CREDITS.md) for its distinct provenance and the built-in font credit.
The generated UI atlas is not part of this Rgsdev pack and is not labeled CC0.
